<b>Songclave Supplies</b> is a [[Delivery Wishes|Delivery Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, acquired from [[Couriers Tipp & Pill]].
__NOTOC__

== Delivery Item ==
[[File:Courier's_Swag.png|link=Courier's Swag|left|thumb|100x100px]]
The [[Courier's Swag]] has a total of 5 hit points. It takes 1 damage for every Mask of damage Hornet takes, and also when Hornet makes a heavy landing, hits a ceiling while using [[Silk Soar]], or runs into a wall while using [[Swift Step]]. Travelling with the [[Bellways]], [[Ventrica]], [[Flea Caravan]] or using the [[Beastling Call]] immediately destroys it.
{{Clear}}
== Wish ==
[[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is given a Courier's Swag by Tipp & Pill to carefully deliver to the [[Caretaker]] in [[Songclave]] in [[Act 2]], or to [[Sherma]] in the same place in [[Act 3]].

This Delivery can be repeated an infinite amount of times, allowing for a steady source of [[Rosaries]]. However, Tipp & Pill will only offer 2 Deliveries at a time. The most recently completed Delivery will never appear twice in a row. In addition, only the first completion of a Delivery contributes towards <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i>.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Tipp & Pill 01.png! Tipp & Pill location in Bellhart
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Sherma 07.png!Caretaker/Sherma location in Songclave
}}

== Possible routes ==
===Exhaust Organ route===
This route goes through [[Greymoor]], [[Sinner's Road]] and the [[Exhaust Organ]] to arrive at the [[Grand Bellway]] in the [[Choral Chambers]]. From there it uses the switchable wheel to reach a hallway leading directly to Songclave.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Songclave Supplies 01.png!Exhaust Organ route
}}
=== Blasted Steps route ===
This route goes through [[Shellwood]], [[Blasted Steps]] and up the [[Grand Gate]] to arrive to the [[Choral Chambers]]. From there it goes up to the [[Citadel Spa]] and the western vertical room to the upper hallways of the area leading directly to Songclave.
{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Songclave Supplies 02.png!Blasted Steps route
}}
== Reward ==
[[File:Rosaries large.png|link=Rosaries|left|thumb|100x100px]]

By turning in the supplies to the Caretaker, he rewards Hornet with {{R|360}}. When turning in supplies to Sherma, he rewards Hornet with {{R|410}}.

{{Clear}}
